findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Lie/DirectSum.lean:74 `def lieModuleOf ... := { lof R ι M j with ... }` and :89 `def lieModuleComponent ... := { component R ι M j with ... }` — no `@[simp]` lemmas follow either, confirming the PR's comment; the repo already uses this named-lemma pattern (TauCeti/Algebra/Lie/Basic.lean:51 `ofBijective_apply`, :77 `congrRight_apply`).
findings.fix: State the missing interface once, before the `def`: `@[simp] lemma lieModuleOf_apply (i) (x : P i) : DirectSum.lieModuleOf R ι L P i x = DirectSum.of P i x := rfl` and `@[simp] lemma lieModuleComponent_apply (i) (x : ⨁ i, P i) : DirectSum.lieModuleComponent R ι L P i x = x i := rfl`, then replace the `change` and the two `simp [DirectSum.lieModuleComponent]` with `simp only` on these lemmas.
findings.issue: `change (∑ i, DirectSum.of P i (g i s)) j = g j s` silently unfolds two bundled wrappers at once (`lieModuleComponent ... j x ≡ x j` and `(lieModuleOf i).comp (g i) s ≡ DirectSum.of P i (g i s)`). The same defeq is relied on undocumented at lines 152 and 153 (`simp [DirectSum.lieModuleComponent]`, unfolding the Mathlib definition), and in the term proofs at lines 175 (`(rfl)`) and 181 (`LieModuleHom.sum_apply _ s`, whose stated RHS only typechecks up to that defeq).

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Basic.lean:441-443 `def IsInternal ... := Function.Bijective (DirectSum.coeAddMonoidHom A)` — an `AddMonoidHom`, whereas `directSumCoe` wraps `DirectSum.coeLinearMap` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/DirectSum/Module.lean:402), so this is a multi-layer defeq; grep shows `bijective_directSumCoe_iff` has no use site in the PR.
findings.fix: Write `LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (directSumCoe N) ((bijective_directSumCoe_iff N).mpr h)` so the defeq is confined to the one documented lemma.
findings.issue: `LieModuleEquiv.ofBijective (directSumCoe N) h` passes `h : DirectSum.IsInternal _` where `Function.Bijective ⇑(directSumCoe N)` is expected, relying on defeq across `LieModuleHom` → `LinearMap` → `AddMonoidHom`, even though `bijective_directSumCoe_iff` (line 91) was just proved to name exactly that identification and is otherwise unused.

summary: The additivity equivalence leans on unfolding Mathlib's `DirectSum.lieModuleOf`/`lieModuleComponent` in five places (a `change`, two definition-unfolding `simp`s, two term-mode `rfl`-level proofs) instead of stating the two missing application lemmas once; and `directSumEquiv` bypasses the bridging lemma proved directly above it in favour of raw defeq.
